subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should cron restart catch-up become public config as raw max/stagger knobs, an explicit skip/freshness policy, or remain internal?
rationale: The implementation gap is clear, but new cron config keys become a compatibility contract and the existing internal max/stagger semantics do not match the requested disable-catch-up behavior.

options.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
options.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults while letting user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

options.title: Expose narrow global knobs
options.body: Publish max/stagger controls only after defining zero-limit behavior and documenting that stagger controls rate pressure rather than stale-message relevance.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config for now and document current restart catch-up behavior while narrower duplicate-rerun bugs are fixed separately.

recommendation.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
recommendation.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults while letting user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing candidate for cron config/product direction based on core cron scheduler history and adjacent startup catch-up ownership.
